mu_name: Flame Strike's flaming blade, 2.5 m at rest and 4.5 m while he whirls it
why_this_one: MODEL_EFFECT_FLAME_STRIKE (ZzzOpenData.cpp:4590-4591), born on the caster's bone 33 at the echo of AT_SKILL_FLAME_STRIKE (236; ZzzCharacter.cpp:4755-4760). LifeTime 35, alpha +0.1 a frame and -0.1 once under 20 (MoveHandlers.cpp:7706-7795). Here the Ancient rune Flame Strike's: see game/fx/flame_strike.
mesh_from: muextract export-obj --action=0 --key=N on Data/Effect/FlameStrike.bmd, from MuMain: one action of 14 keys, 2 meshes, 280 triangles.
poses_from: Its only two shapes: keys 0 and 10-13 are the short blade, keys 1-9 the long one (its bones Sphere02/03 and Bone04 out from 1.6 m to 3.6 m); blended as the key passes 0-1 and 9-10.

parts.note: Data/Effect/firehik02.OZJ, 64 square, an orange-yellow flame: the blade, RENDER_BRIGHT, added at its alpha; also the third of the struck body's flames (BITMAP_FIRE_CURSEDLICH subtype 4).
Data/Effect/flamestani.OZJ, 256 square, four flame frames down V: added, a quarter every 80 ms (ZzzEffect.cpp:9248-9274).
Data/Effect/lava.OZJ, 128 by 64: BITMAP_LAVA, ribbon C, Sphere01 to Sphere03 (ZzzEffectBlurSpark.cpp:352-364). Not a group of the mesh.
Data/Effect/firehik01.OZJ, 64 square: BITMAP_FIRE_HIK1, a struck body's rising flame (ZzzEffectParticle.cpp:1843-1852). Not a group of the mesh.
Data/Effect/firehik03.OZJ, 64 square: BITMAP_FIRE_HIK3, a struck body's rising flame (ZzzEffectParticle.cpp:1920-1929). Not a group of the mesh.
